title: Mio looking at her phone, round 3 (ipa7a-1001 with her own glasses)
question: Which one has her glasses right?

media.caption: Every attempt in the order it was made, each beside the approved portrait at the same scale. Only the glasses band changed; the rest of ipa7a-1001 is pixel for pixel the same.
The whole pictures: approved portrait, ipa7a-1001 before, then every attempt.
